channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Activists are suppressing research into gender-affirming care. It has to stop
item.description: An endocrinologist warns activists are stifling research on pediatric gender-affirming treatments, undermining evidence-based medicine and putting vulnerable youth at risk.

item.title: Striving for a more perfect union
item.description: As the U.S. nears its 250th anniversary, Gov. Josh Stein reflects on North Carolina’s pivotal role in independence, the Bill of Rights and the ongoing work of American democracy.

item.title: Judge’s ruling could mean good news for smaller NC political parties
item.description: A federal judge ruled North Carolina’s elections board violated the Constitution by denying ballot access to the Justice For All Party, a decision that could shape fights over small-party access.

item.title: Give Senator Tillis credit for finally saying and doing the right things
item.description: Once a Republican who often backed Trump, Sen. Thom Tillis is now publicly breaking with him on immigration, Ukraine and abuses of power, drawing praise from North Carolina commentators.

item.title: Police: Abandoned dog and refusal to return pet lead to charges
item.description: Two Wilson women face charges after one allegedly abandoned a dog on a porch during a winter storm and another allegedly refused to return the stray during the subsequent investigation, according to Wilson County Sheriff's Office officials.

item.title: Resident: God, doorbell, smoke detectors saved lives
item.description: After an early-morning blaze tore through his Wilson home, a father credits God, a stuck doorbell and smoke detectors with saving him and his daughter as firefighters contain the accidental fire.

item.title: Area Calendar, Feb. 4-5, 2026
item.description: Area sports calendar for Feb. 4-5, 2026, listing college basketball and lacrosse plus boys, girls and JV high school basketball matchups across local schools.

item.title: MIDDLE SCHOOL RESULT: Vikings maul Phillips, face Trojans with playoff berth at stake
item.description: Elm City Middle beat Phillips 49-24 to set up a finale at Darden with TAC playoff hopes on the line, as Jaylen Pender led the Vikings with 16 points.

item.title: WCA girls extend, end win streak
item.description: Wilson Christian’s girls pushed their win streak to five with a win at Faith Christian before Wilmington Christian snapped it, leaving the Lady Chargers 16-7 and atop NCCSA 2-A East District 3.

item.title: Basketball packed into Thursday and Friday as winter weather disrupts Wilson slate again
item.description: Winter weather has scrambled Wilson County high school sports, packing postponed basketball into Thursday and Friday and forcing new dates for state swimming and dual-team wrestling events.
